name: agentenv
description: Install and track agent-harness setup (skills, MCP servers, hooks) from one package list.

scripts.check: npm run check:eol && npm run check:scripts && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm test && npm run e2e
scripts.check:scripts: node --check scripts/check-eol.mjs && node --check scripts/e2e.mjs && node --check scripts/e2e-list.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node scripts/e2e.mjs && node scripts/e2e-list.mjs
